record.original_question: Let X1 and X2 be smooth projective varieties over a field K, and let D1 and D2 be admissible subcategories of Db(X1) and Db(X2). If F: D1 -> D2 is an exact equivalence, does there exist a Fourier-Mukai equivalence between D1 and D2?

evidence.quote: Question 1.8. Let F : D1 -> D2 be an exact equivalence between admissible subcategories Di -> Db (Xi ), for Xi smooth projective over K. Is there a Fourier-Mukai equivalence D1 = D2?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a field, and let $X_1$ and $X_2$ be smooth projective varieties over $K$. Denote by $D^b(X_i)$ the bounded derived category of coherent sheaves on $X_i$. Recall that a full triangulated subcategory $\mathcal{D} \subseteq D^b(X_i)$ is called admissible if its inclusion functor admits both a left and a right adjoint. Recall also that, given an object $P \in D^b(X_1 \times X_2)$, the associated Fourier–Mukai functor is $\Phi_P(-) := R\pi_{2,*}(L\pi_1^*(-) \otimes^{L} P)$, where $\pi_i: X_1 \times X_2 \to X_i$ are the projections; an exact equivalence $G: \mathcal{D}_1 \to \mathcal{D}_2$ between admissible subcategories $\mathcal{D}_i \subseteq D^b(X_i)$ is said to be of Fourier–Mukai type if it is the restriction of $\Phi_P$ for some kernel $P \in D^b(X_1 \times X_2)$.

Question: Suppose $\mathcal{D}_1 \subseteq D^b(X_1)$ and $\mathcal{D}_2 \subseteq D^b(X_2)$ are admissible subcategories, and let $F: \mathcal{D}_1 \to \mathcal{D}_2$ be an exact equivalence of triangulated categories. Does there necessarily exist a Fourier–Mukai equivalence (i.e. an equivalence of Fourier–Mukai type) between $\mathcal{D}_1$ and $\mathcal{D}_2$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is widely regarded as open in general. Orlov's classical theorem handles the case where $\mathcal{D}_i = D^b(X_i)$, and Kuznetsov has formulated a related conjecture for splitting functors. Recent progress establishes the Fourier–Mukai property for exact equivalences of admissible components in particular geometric situations (e.g. Kuznetsov components of cubic fourfolds, Gushel–Mukai varieties, quartic double solids), but no general answer is known.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Orlov proved that every exact fully faithful functor with adjoints between the bounded derived categories of coherent sheaves on smooth projective varieties is of Fourier–Mukai type... Kuznetsov conjectured that a splitting functor between bounded derived categories of coherent sheaves on smooth projective varieties is of Fourier–Mukai type.
status_evidence.claim: General Fourier–Mukai representability for equivalences of admissible subcategories remains an open problem, with only partial results in specific settings.

status_evidence.title: Yoga for Fourier–Mukai partnership
status_evidence.snippet: For Gieseker-Mori varieties of odd dimension or quartic double solids over ℂ, every exact equivalence is of Fourier–Mukai type.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results are known in special geometric cases, indicating the general question is still open.
